rationale: Because Clarence Thomas is the most senior justice in the majority and the conference shows a clear textualist through-line (specific-and-later proviso preventing § 2680(a) from swallowing § 2680(h)), he is most likely to assign and keep the majority opinion. Separate writings are likely on both sides: the dissenters to press the anti-implied-repeal/sovereign-immunity-clear-statement view, and one or more majority justices to cabin the holding against overreading and to address Gaubert “level of abstraction” concerns.
